title: SOC SITREP #SOC-0325-01: Ransomware Confirmed on MES and File Servers

fields.incidentName: .ironmelt Ransomware: MES and File Servers, Rockford Data Center
fields.from: SOC Shift Lead (phoned in from SOC line (815) 555-0122)
fields.to: Chief Information Security Officer; Business Continuity Manager
fields.summary: CONFIRMED: MES servers ICM-MES-01 and ICM-MES-02 and file servers ICM-FS-03 and ICM-FS-04 at the Rockford data center are encrypted. The encrypted files have the extension .ironmelt. Every share has a ransom note named IRON_MELT_README.txt. It demands 18 million dollars in cryptocurrency within 72 hours and says 1.2 TB of data will be published. SUSPECTED: lateral movement toward Plant 2 Beloit. UNKNOWN: the state of the Beloit file server and of the ERP integration. The integration account is locked, and we cannot yet tell whether the encryption or our 14:25 isolation caused it. 'Still being assessed' means not yet known. It does not mean unaffected.

keyStatus.value: ENCRYPTED: confirmed, ransom note on all shares

keyStatus.label: ICM-FS-04 file server
keyStatus.value: ENCRYPTED: confirmed, ransom note on all shares

keyStatus.value: UNKNOWN: integration account locked, cause not determined

actions.text: Plant 3 Dubuque reported a hung MES to the service desk.
SOC analyst confirmed mass file encryption on ICM-FS-03, ICM-FS-04 and the MES hosts; incident opened.
CISO Anil Deshmukh notified by the SOC under IDCCI 2.
CISO ordered network isolation at the Rockford data center; inter-site links and remote access cut.
Copy of IRON_MELT_README.txt and sample .ironmelt files preserved to evidence storage; hashes recorded.
CEO declared Level 3; Crisis Management Team bridge opened.
Analyst assigned to the Beloit file server and the locked ERP integration account.

planned: Determine whether the Beloit file server shows encryption or attacker activity, using the isolated console only.
Determine the cause of the ERP integration account lockout: encryption, attacker activity or our isolation.
Keep all affected hosts powered on and isolated for forensics; no reimaging or cleanup.
Support CISO in briefing forensic firm Blackwater Cyber on scope and evidence collected so far.
Identify the initial access point and the accounts used for lateral movement.
issues: Ransomware on a manufacturing system is confirmed. Under IDCCI 2, the CISO must notify the General Counsel within one hour.
No system is to be restored from backup until the forensic firm confirms the backup is clean (IBIARO 4). Backup integrity has not yet been checked.
The SOC cannot see the Beloit file server or the ERP integration while the network is isolated. Remote access must be authorized before the assessment can go on.
Ransom note demands and the 72-hour deadline are not to be discussed outside the CMT.

instructorNote: This page sets the confirmed, suspected and unknown facts that the rest of the exercise builds on. Watch whether the CISO briefs the CMT in those three parts without letting 'still being assessed' be heard as 'fine', and whether the BCM opens the recovery tracker with the MES disruption starting at 14:05 (8-hour RTO red at 22:05, MTPD Friday 14:05) and the first plant-control checkpoint at 18:05.
